methodology: Use only the institutions' current official catalog, policy, academic-owner, and course-description pages.
Compose requirements rather than semester schedules, suggested plans, accelerated graduate pathways, or honors paths.
Model every mandatory major, general-education or college, and university-graduation layer needed to close the ordinary bachelor's degree.
Preserve mutually exclusive concentrations and material alternate routes without adding them together.
Treat scoped upper-level rules as scoped rules; do not invent an aggregate upper-division minimum when the catalog states none.
Retain catalog contradictions as data-quality evidence instead of silently normalizing them.
